```json
{
  "updated": "2026-09-07T14:52:08.637078+00:00",
  "authority": "observer work queue; not a live scheduler",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "P01",
      "runtime_role": "source-preflight",
      "status": "ready",
      "task": "Refresh governing source hashes and read changed passages before the next run.",
      "inputs": [
        "SESSION_SYNC.md",
        "SOURCE_REFRESH_CORRECTIONS.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "source manifest with read scope",
        "resolved or explicitly held source conflicts"
      ],
      "acceptance": "No historical source observation is repeated as a current defect without a reread."
    },
    {
      "id": "P02",
      "runtime_role": "soulbae-packet",
      "status": "pending",
      "task": "Prepare and freeze the first Privacy Is Value packet using the existing experiment brief.",
      "inputs": [
        "../share/first-dual-runtime/EXPERIMENT.md",
        "VTA_SHARED_MEMORY_PILOT.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "task.json",
        "sources.json",
        "packet.md",
        "freeze manifest"
      ],
      "acceptance": "Packet <=600 words; five required distinctions; source/version/hash; public or approved material only. Existing memory fixtures are inputs, not automatically this deliverable."
    },
    {
      "id": "P03",
      "runtime_role": "soulbis-review",
      "status": "awaiting P02 and separate runtime",
      "task": "Other model reviews frozen packet and governing sources.",
      "inputs": [
        "../share/first-dual-runtime/EXPERIMENT.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "review.md",
        "per-criterion verdicts",
        "reproducible challenges"
      ],
      "acceptance": "Preserve disagreement; author does not certify own work. Runtime identity and actual isolation limits recorded."
    },
    {
      "id": "P04",
      "runtime_role": "vta-replay",
      "status": "awaiting scoped adapter",
      "task": "Exercise approved and denied fixtures through actual VTA interfaces.",
      "inputs": [
        "VTA_SHARED_MEMORY_PILOT.md",
        "MODEL_TO_BUILD_DECISIONS.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "adapter scope report",
        "replay-results.json",
        "corrections.md"
      ],
      "acceptance": "Real dispatch distinguished from mock and auth bypass; unavailable distinguished from denied. No production keys or services used."
    },
    {
      "id": "P05",
      "runtime_role": "receipt-contract",
      "status": "pending source reconciliation",
      "task": "Resolve native run receipt versus witness/VRC schema and issuer authority.",
      "inputs": [
        "../share/first-dual-runtime/EXPERIMENT.md",
        "SETUP_SIMPLIFICATION.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "contract crosswalk",
        "unsigned candidate bundle",
        "verification checklist tied to actual schema"
      ],
      "acceptance": "No invented credential schema or automatic issuance. Signing/publication remains a separate authorized step."
    },
    {
      "id": "P06",
      "runtime_role": "workshop-art",
      "status": "ready",
      "task": "Survey main-site workshop lattice art and design distinct detailed mage visuals for Labs.",
      "inputs": [
        "PORTFOLIO_CURATION.md",
        "CITY_EXPANSION_REVIEW.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "reference catalogue with exact source components",
        "visual-to-craft mapping",
        "local fund artwork and browser review"
      ],
      "acceptance": "Distinct Shor/precompile, distinct disciplines, coherent lattice language; no production edits."
    },
    {
      "id": "P07",
      "runtime_role": "register-seat-audit",
      "status": "ready",
      "task": "Reconcile full research register parser and City seat-source conflicts.",
      "inputs": [
        "ATLAS_MATH_REFLECTION.md",
        "CITY_EXPANSION_REVIEW.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "register parser findings and fixtures",
        "seat reconciliation manifest"
      ],
      "acceptance": "Do not equate C IDs with lattice coordinates; refresh C97 status; field-level provenance and anticipated/current states."
    },
    {
      "id": "P08",
      "runtime_role": "skill-adoption",
      "status": "pending contract survey",
      "task": "Map harness practices into existing skills packages and adoption receipts.",
      "inputs": [
        "HARNESS_SKILL_ADOPTION.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "existing-schema crosswalk",
        "one evidence-backed package draft",
        "adoption fixture"
      ],
      "acceptance": "Reuse SkillSync; contextual replay counts, no global reputation or automatic authority."
    },
    {
      "id": "P09",
      "runtime_role": "corpus-projections",
      "status": "after reviewed findings",
      "task": "Prepare docs disposition, staged Spellweb graph additions and a guide-template prototype.",
      "inputs": [
        "CORPUS_INTEGRATION_AGENDA.md",
        "UNIVERSE_DISTRIBUTION.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "disposition register",
        "dry-run graph patch",
        "forkable guide template"
      ],
      "acceptance": "Stable IDs and source/journal lineage; no bulk promotion, fresh C IDs, deployment or binding."
    },
    {
      "id": "P10",
      "runtime_role": "city-governance",
      "status": "after contract reconciliation",
      "task": "Hone City admin and farm lifecycle against accepted decisions.",
      "inputs": [
        "PROGRAMME_OVERVIEW.md",
        "SETUP_SIMPLIFICATION.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "plugin-shaped local prototype",
        "isolated lifecycle fixture"
      ],
      "acceptance": "Desired state is not enforced state; permission withdrawal checked through consumer. No production BIND/VTA mutation."
    },
    {
      "id": "P11",
      "runtime_role": "funding-later",
      "status": "roadmap only",
      "task": "Survey existing x402, ENS, Zypher and City pool integrations before proposing new rails.",
      "inputs": [
        "FUNDING_POOLS_AND_RECEIPTS.md"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "existing-implementation map",
        "scoped future plan"
      ],
      "acceptance": "Immediate donation stays DONATE_UA, no inscription required. Do not restart speculative stablecoin checkout as current priority."
    },
    {
      "id": "P12",
      "runtime_role": "labs-cleanup",
      "status": "partial; review remains",
      "task": "Consolidate local Labs iterations while retaining cybersecurity-led services and current research distinctions.",
      "inputs": [
        "LABS_CLEANUP_PASS.md",
        "LABS_CLEANUP_AUDIT.json"
      ],
      "deliverables": [
        "single ownership map for templates/data",
        "reviewable local cleanup",
        "desktop/mobile verification"
      ],
      "acceptance": "No historical evidence deletion, production edits or invented runtime outcomes."
    }
  ],
  "current_priority": "Integrated Labs and City polish; see NEW_WINDOW_SITES_BRIEF.md",
  "execution_order_override": [
    "site inspection and source refresh",
    "coherent local preview",
    "user design review",
    "deployment readiness review",
    "resume bounded research runtime queue"
  ],
  "master_ecosystem_workstream": {
    "plan": "LAYERED_RUNTIME.json",
    "journey": "../journeys/2026-09-07_the-entrance-and-the-agent.md",
    "evidence": "master-ecosystem-2026-09-07",
    "scope": "Local partial milestones; existing broad task statuses retained",
    "next": "Native carriers and one actual agent workshop rehearsal adapter after source refresh"
  }
}
```
